title: Dream locations
content: Has anyone been to a Video game store that’s basically a Circuit city? They seem to sell Pokémon cards also. One of the most unique things about this place is what ever game you pick becomes the new dream environment. I’m typically playing myself in RuneScape classics, Pokémon Red and Call of duty zombies. The call of duty zombies in particular always has the same non existent maps as the selections. I typically become lucid visiting this place and playing this specific game. Also there’s some sonic the hedgehog/Mario 64 cross which is interesting, I can only recall playin this 5 or 6 times. Going to the Pokémon card section usually ports me to a different location entirely. Either the school or some sort of scouts camp.
